summary: Combined check submission on the accepted v1 map: it creates the second Candidate (claim-truncate-store-failure-watermark) and immediately fixes and runs its direct check. The defect is a fault-handling gap the code acknowledges itself: appendEntries deletes the conflicting suffix (raft.go 1524-1533) and, if the subsequent StoreLogs of the replacement entries fails, returns at raft.go 1544 leaving r.lastLog/lastLogIdx still naming the deleted indices (the author's own TODO 'leaving r.getLastLog() in the wrong state if there was a truncation above'). The obligation requires that after such a partial failure the follower's in-memory watermark not exceed the log it durably holds, because getLastIndex backs AppendEntriesResponse.LastLog, which the leader's recovery uses (nextIndex = max(min(nextIndex-1, resp.LastLog+1),1)) while only a leader-side ErrLogNotFound would trigger a snapshot. Binding bind-append-entries-store-failure locates raft.go 1524-1543 (symbol Raft.appendEntries). draft/plan.json fixes the harness (go_test, no source/files inline), prerequisites admit=append_request and store=store_after_failure, admission_alias=admit, and one event_assertion property: under trigger write_failed==true, the result event's raft_last_log_index must equal the store prerequisite's store_last_index. draft/assurance_generated_test.go seeds a real InmemStore with [1@1,2@1,3@2], wraps only StoreLogs to fail on demand, builds Raft with the internal skipStartup flag, drives one well-formed conflicting AppendEntries (PrevLogEntry=2, PrevLogTerm=1, entry 3@5, LeaderCommitIndex=0) and emits the watermark and store index. I compiled and ran the exact controller command locally in a scratch copy (draft/cc1, not part of the submission): it builds, the test passes, and go test -json yields three parseable CA_EVENTs with the observation {"raft_last_log_index":3,"raft_last_log_term":2,"store_last_index":2,"write_failed":true,"reported_success":false} - i.e. the watermark still counts the deleted index 3 while the durable log ends at 2, so the equality oracle is expected to record a violation witness pending the checker_correspondence review. Preflight validation returns valid with no diagnostics. The scratch compile copy draft/cc1 can be removed; it is a local verification artifact only.
